name: Handpicked Tamarind
description:
Bring the authentic taste of tradition to your kitchen with our Premium Handpicked Tamarind. Sourced from sun-drenched orchards, each pod is selected by hand to ensure the perfect balance of tangy richness and natural sweetness. Unlike mass-processed alternatives, our tamarind is processed using time-honored methods to preserve its vibrant flavor and essential nutrients.
​Key Features
​Traditionally Harvested: Hand-selected by local artisans to ensure only the ripest, high-quality pods make the cut.
​100% Natural & Pure: Free from artificial colors, preservatives, or added salt. Just pure, unadulterated tamarind.
​Rich & Tangy Flavor: High pulp content provides a deep, concentrated tartness that elevates any dish.
​Expertly Processed: Carefully cleaned and fiber-stripped, making it easy to soak and extract pulp quickly.
​Versatile Culinary Essential: The secret ingredient for authentic curries, chutneys, sambars, sauces, and refreshing beverages.

Why Choose Handpicked?
​Mass-produced tamarind often includes immature fruit and excess debris. By choosing handpicked, you are guaranteed a cleaner product with a more consistent flavor profile. Our traditional drying process ensures the tamarind retains its dark, rich color and high tartaric acid levels, providing that signature "zing" your recipes deserve.
shortDescription: Premium Traditionally Handpicked Tamarind
approvalNote: Proper value for 500 gms to be given
